messages:
ash: Noticed a spike of ProvisioningPending in eu-west-3 warm-pool after afternoon rollout. Seems tied to the key-rotation change for regional KMS.
junaid: Which rotation? I saw KP-2026-110 merged this morning. Did it change any cross-account bindings?
ash: It rotated the CMK and tightened the key policy to remove a legacy principal. Keystore proxy can reach KMS but decrypt returns AccessDenied. Logs show sts:AssumeRole denied.
ops-bot: change-bot: KP-2026-110 applied to eu-west-3 at 2026-03-28T15:20Z.
net-admin: Also rolled a VPC egress policy tighten (FW-2026-900) an hour later that replaced permissive NAT egress; could be coincidental.
junaid: paste logs: ```
keystore ERROR: decrypt failed: AccessDenied for arn:aws:kms:eu-west-3:111222333444:key/abcd-efgh
agent.join: state=ProvisioningPending reason=\"kms assume role denied\" attempts=3
```
ash: We couldn't revert fast because key-policy edits require kms-admin role; role-boundary blocks our usual sprint.
net-admin: Temporary mitigation I ran: created a scoped exception route for warm-pool to an internal fallback NAT and added a short-lived key grant for the keystore principal (ttl=25m). Commands: `infractl route add --rtb warm-pool-ew3 --target nat-fallback-ew3 --expires 25m` and `infractl kms grant create --key abcd-efgh --grantee keystore@redwood --ttl 25m`.
ops-bot: monitor: warm-pool-ew3 healthy_nodes: 7 -> 46 (8m).
junaid: Recovery confirmed. Cost hit: churn + rewarm ~6 GPU-hours (~USD 1.6k). Add to incident cost.
ash: Immediate follow-ups: (1) revert the key-policy change to reinstate the scoped keystore principal, (2) update key-rotation checklist to verify keystore assume-role in CI, (3) runbook to allow ops to create time-limited grants without full kms-admin role (audited).
net-admin: Also will change egress rollout practice: apply allowlist entries for service NATs before deny rules and add a preroll e2e that attempts a KMS decrypt from a canary.
compliance-bot: exception created id=EXC-EW3-2026-77; operator=net-admin; reason=\"temp NAT route + kms grant to recover warm-pool after key rotation\"; ttl=2026-03-28T15:45Z. Audit trail attached.
ash: Filing incident: https://issues.internal/RED-IF-12121 "key rotation + egress tighten -> keystore assume denied -> warm-pool onboarding churn". Linking logs and cost.
junaid: I'll open the PR to fix KP-2026-110 and add the simulated assume-role test. Thanks all.
